_comment: Canonical identity-124 map IDs. legacy31 and legacy54 are the translated training splits from the curated maps-round2 catalogue; their heldout sets complete the 31- and 54-map waves. training-111 is every map except heldout-13, the split for training on the whole catalogue. heldout-13 keeps the 13-map size of legacy54-heldout and 9 of its grass maps (8 of which were already legacy31-heldout, so those stay held out across every wave), and adds 3 snow and 1 space map: legacy54-heldout is entirely grass, which cannot measure transfer to the one level type that is mechanically different. Less of the rarer type is held out than proportion would give (1 of 22 space, 3 of 38 snow, 9 of 64 grass) because the policy has to learn the space mechanic from training maps first. Snow and space picks are evenly spaced through their ID bands, one per band.
